definition: An imaginary sphere centered on Earth, used to represent directions toward celestial objects.
intuition: Imagine stars fixed to a huge spherical surface. Although the stars lie at different distances, we can describe their directions using points on that sphere.
misconceptions: The celestial sphere is not a physical shell.
Stars represented on it are not equally distant from Earth.
takeaway: A map of directions, not of distances.

source.section: Looking Out from a Spinning, Round Earth
